items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: No, but I've heard of him, but I don't know him personally.

ctx.x: Yeah, no, I don't remember him. Do you remember him? No. I might have his picture in my insight.
What about Walter Grundy? That was one of Baby's teachers. Do you remember him?
No, but I've heard of him, but I don't know him personally. I've heard a lot of him.
